admission.justification: Guarded by test_knowledge_integrity_check_compacts_routes_and_worklist_without_overflow and prevents 100+ family route rows or large worklists from overflowing the inline answer and hiding validation counts.

applicability: Every MCP knowledge_integrity_check answer projected through application/knowledge_integrity_answer.py::integrity_answer.
conditions: The validated integrity payload contains family route rows or a persisted leaf worklist.
exclusions: The complete validated payload logged in the daily tool log and full per-family rows emitted by agents-remember knowledge-routes.
statement: knowledge_integrity_check projects routes as summary counts and worklist as path, digest, itemCount, state, owner, and itemsByKind without inlining per-family route rows or worklist items.
title: knowledge_integrity_check summarizes routes and worklist inline
